title: What Would an LLM Do? Evaluating Policymaking Capabilities of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of human capabilities (based on Martha Nussbaum's Capability Approach) prioritized in LLMs' top policy choices for homelessness mitigation, and comparing them to local domain experts to reveal a systemic bias toward immediate physical safety interventions over relational or structural empowerment.

Comparing LLM policy choice rankings across specific geographic locations (Barcelona, Johannesburg, South Bend) versus universal scenarios to evaluate whether the models adapt to local sociopolitical contexts or apply a rigid, context-blind heuristic.
